narrative.overview: LadderFrame presents an authoritative, high-taste editorial design system crafted for B2B Enterprise Founders and C-level executives.
keyCharacteristics: Dual-font pairing: Cormorant Garamond serif display headers paired with Plus Jakarta Sans body type.
Porcelain White (#ffffff) card surfaces with hairline borders and ambient drop shadows.
Sparse Antique Gold (#9a6b32) accents for high-contrast visual authority.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: The Antique Gold accent is used sparingly on ≤10% of any screen viewport.

dos: Do maintain strict font separation: Cormorant Garamond for titles & numbers; Plus Jakarta Sans for body prose.
Do preserve 2-column staggered layout physics for bottleneck marquee cards.
donts: Don't use bright neon colors or generic blue accents.
Don't clutter section headers with unneeded extra card boxes.
